basis: Defined by early-onset autoimmunity and immune dysregulation; no specific organ damage established by the supplied record.
Motor neuronopathy; muscle wasting in 7/8 and biopsy atrophy in 2/3; left ventricular hypertrophy in 2/6 (~33%), with limited sample size.
Nonsyndromic hearing loss with cochlear and vestibular aqueduct abnormalities.
Chronic inflammation of the stomach; infectious or autoimmune causation is not universal across this umbrella.
Astrogliopathy affecting brainstem, spinal cord and white matter; dysphagia, nystagmus and bladder symptoms reflect neurologic dysfunction.
Cystic teratomas are predominantly ovarian; this umbrella supplies no covered organ of origin. Tissue components do not establish additional organ involvement.
Benign neuronal/glial neoplasm arising in the cerebral hemispheres.
Developmental impairment and structural CNS abnormalities define the syndrome; urinary tract abnormalities occur in 30-79%.
Inherited retinal degeneration causing night blindness, visual field loss and reduced acuity.
Neurodevelopmental impairment and skeletal malformations define the syndrome; cardiovascular malformations occur in 30-79%. Renal and major eye defects are under 30%.
Subcutaneous fat loss with insulin resistance; hepatic steatosis and cardiomyopathy each reported in 30-79%. Associated autoimmunity alone does not establish an immune mechanism.
Anemia defined by reduced red blood cell volume.
Malignancy involving lymph nodes within the hematolymphoid system; includes metastatic carcinoma, so the lymphoma-specific immune label is not universal.
Developmental delay, intellectual disability and epilepsy define the disorder. Strabismus in 2 assessed patients and other isolated findings do not establish common extra-neural damage.
Primary arterial hypertension; renal, retinal and cerebrovascular complications are separately diagnosed diseases.
Degeneration of intervertebral discs; nerve compression is not established as common across the umbrella.
Urothelial carcinoma arising in the urethra, which belongs to the urinary axis.
Congenital skeletal fusion involving the hand and first metacarpal.
Allelic umbrella defined by tubulointerstitial kidney disease, antibody deficiency or congenital neutropenia; these are alternative defining presentations, with uncertain distribution.
Disease of the parotid salivary gland; salivary glands belong to the gastrointestinal axis.
Malignant neoplasm arising in the posterior urethra.
Inherited vitreoretinal disease with retinal folds, degeneration and detachment; neurodevelopmental involvement is not established for this specific subtype.
Neoplasm involving the uvea of the eye.
Carcinoma arising in the lacrimal gland, part of the ocular axis.
Ischemic necrosis of a reproductive organ; the definition does not establish endocrine dysfunction or a primary vascular disease.
